summary: Frontend-only test of new landing FeatureShowcase + course grid and /courses page via Playwright (1920px & 390px). All requested features work: 10 feature tabs switch preview title, auto-rotate after 5s (Get hired -> Kali wraps), pauses on hover, CTA -> /register. Landing #courses grid shows 8 cards in 4 columns (293px x4), 'See all 13 courses' -> /courses. Card hrefs/target/type/title/price/mrp(line-through)/off verified for 803635 (₹4,859/₹14,999/67% OFF) and 585979 (₹486/₹2,999/83% OFF). /courses: 13 cards, 0 broken images, filter counts 13/7/5/1 and filtering correct, search (wireshark=1, CEH=2, CEH+Tests=1), empty state shown, visit-store link correct (_blank). nav-courses navigates to /courses. Hero alert feed still renders and adds items. Mobile 390px: 1-column grids, no horizontal overflow. No page errors.

issues: Nav links incl. nav-courses are 'hidden md:flex' and there is no hamburger/mobile menu, so mobile users cannot reach /courses, /catalog, /talent from the header (pre-existing pattern, now more noticeable with new Courses page).

action_items: (Low) Add a mobile menu to PublicNav so Courses/Catalog/Hire talent are reachable on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: Course prices/discounts are static hardcoded data scraped from socprofessionals; will drift from the live store over time.
FeatureShowcase auto-rotate interval resets only on hover change; manual tab click doesn't reset the 5s timer, so preview may switch shortly after a click (minor UX).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 covered only public landing FeatureShowcase, landing course grid and /courses page (static data in src/lib/courses.js). All passing. Only open item: no mobile nav menu.
